shared_elements: incised/carved markings on a large upright surface
possible small anthropomorphic figures (relief figure in A; faint small figures at the top of the panel in B)
justification: A depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with a headdress, arms and a prominent circular disc/pectoral on the chest, its motifs organised around the body; B depicts a flat rectangular panel filled with long horizontal registers of small repeated linear signs, with at most a few tiny faint figures near the top. The only correspondence is the generic one of incised motifs, perhaps including small human-like forms, on a tall vertical stone field; the organising logic (body-shaped iconic image vs. ruled horizontal text-like rows) is entirely different.
